$comment: MONTHLY EDIT LIVES HERE. Title, issue date, the 'read the full issue' link and every archive row come automatically from the latest sent campaign in the Mailchimp folder named 'CMGT Newsletter' (MAILCHIMP_NEWSLETTER_FOLDER_ID). Only the fields Mailchimp cannot know are edited by hand each month: heroImg, heroAlt, ogImage, inThisIssue, and the whole ask block. dek is optional — leave it empty and the campaign's preview text is used. slug/issueLabel/title are the pre-send fallback only: once a campaign has been sent they are overwritten by the campaign. When no campaign has been fetched yet (pre-send, folder id not set, or Mailchimp unreachable) this whole block renders as-is so the page still builds.

newsletter.name: CMGT Board Newsletter
newsletter.description: The CMGT Board Newsletter: one email a month for Gulf South HOA and condo boards — plain-English guidance on budgets, reserves, insurance, and HOA law. Read the current issue, browse past issues, or ask us a question.
newsletter.subscribeBlurb: One email a month, written for volunteer board members across Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Texas, and the Florida Panhandle. No industry-speak, no sales pitch. Unsubscribe anytime.

current.title: Budget Season, Without the Guesswork
current.dek: September is when next year takes shape. Across the 400+ communities we manage, our accounting team and community managers are building draft budgets right now — and walking every board through them line by line, in plain English.
current.heroAlt: An HOA board treasurer working on community finances at a clubhouse table with a laptop open

ask.title: Ask a Budget Question
ask.body: No question is too small — whether CMGT manages your community today or your board is weighing a change. A CMGT community manager answers personally, usually within one business day.

Do we have to raise assessments?
